_comment: What a memory is called, worked out from its value and text. The hub names
each memory in its light list (`memory_title` in
names a memory it read whole (`memoryTitle` in
mycelium-frontend/src/lib/memory-preview.ts), so a row reads the same in a
list and when it's opened. The rule: a structured value's `title`, trimmed,
else the first line of its text that isn't blank or `---`, with a leading
heading's `#`s dropped and cut at `max_chars` characters (code points, not
UTF-16 units), else the key. A structured value with no `text` is named by
